title: commitcoach commit.snapshot event
description: One commit and its changes relative to the first parent (or the empty tree for a root commit). Produced by `commitcoach export` and by the post-commit hook. Schema version 1.0.

event_type.description: Always commit.snapshot, for hook captures and manual exports alike.

captured_at.description: When this document was produced (RFC 3339, UTC). Not a commit date.

files.description: Changed files in Git's order (by path), at most the file limit (100 by default).

warnings.description: Human-readable notes: merge comparison, limits reached, lossy UTF-8 conversions, git messages.

objectId.description: Full object name in lowercase hex (40 characters for SHA-1 repositories, 64 for SHA-256).

name.description: Directory name of the repository, for display only. Not unique.

current_branch.description: Branch checked out when the document was produced (not necessarily a branch containing the commit). null when HEAD is detached.

parents.description: Parents as recorded in the commit object, first parent first. Empty for a root commit.

message.description: Full commit message, unmodified (usually ends with a newline).

authored_at.description: RFC 3339 with the author's UTC offset.

committed_at.description: RFC 3339 with the committer's UTC offset.

strategy.description: first_parent: compared with commit.parents[0] (ordinary and merge commits). empty_tree: root commit compared with the empty tree.

base_sha.description: The first parent, or null for empty_tree.

status.description: Git's change letter: A added, M modified, D deleted, R renamed, T type changed (file/symlink/submodule), and other letters Git may report.

old_path.description: Repository-relative path before the change; null when added.

new_path.description: Repository-relative path after the change; null when deleted.

additions.description: Added lines; null when Git cannot count lines (binary).

deletions.description: Deleted lines; null when Git cannot count lines (binary).

patch.description: Unified diff text as printed by git diff-tree, possibly cut at a limit. null exactly when omitted_reason is set.

patch_truncated.description: patch was cut at the per-file or per-event size limit.

omitted_reason.description: Why patch is null: binary file, a path that looks like it holds secrets, or the per-event patch limit was already used up.

omitted_files.description: Changed files left out of files by the file limit (changed_files - included_files).

truncated.description: true when a limit cut the file list or any patch (patch_truncated or omitted_reason total_patch_limit).
